description: Composite provenance figure: pTyr fit test, active-site distance geometry, and AlphaFold confidence across the four PTP loops of SDF-9
code:
import requests, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def parse(txt,chain=None):
    res={};order=[];het=[]
    for L in txt.split('\n'):
        if len(L)<54: continue
        rec=L[:6]
        if rec not in ('ATOM  ','HETATM') or L[16] not in (' ','A'): continue
        rn=L[17:20].strip(); ch=L[21]; ri=L[22:27]; nm=L[12:16].strip()
        if len(L)>=78 and L[76:78].strip()=='H': continue
        x=np.array([float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54])])
        b=float(L[60:66]) if len(L)>=66 and L[60:66].strip() else 0.
        if chain and ch!=chain: continue
        if rec=='ATOM  ' and rn in AA3:
            k=(ch,ri)
            if k not in res: res[k]={'rn':rn,'atoms':{},'ri':int(ri[:4]),'b':b}; order.append(k)
            res[k]['atoms'][nm]=x
            if nm=='CA': res[k]['b']=b
        elif rec=='HETATM' and rn!='HOH': het.append((ch,rn,int(L[22:26]),nm,x))
    return dict(order=order,res=res,het=het)
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc=P.mean(0);qc=Q.mean(0);V,S,Wt=np.linalg.svd((P-pc).T@(Q-qc))
    return V@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@Wt))])@Wt,pc,qc
AF=requests.get('https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-G5EGA9-F1-model_v6.pdb',headers=H,timeout=120).text
PY=requests.get('https://files.rcsb.org/download/1PTY.pdb',headers=H,timeout=120).text
sdf=parse(AF); pty=parse(PY,'A')
rS={sdf['res'][k]['ri']:sdf['res'][k] for k in sdf['order']}
rP={pty['res'][k]['ri']:pty['res'][k] for k in pty['order']}
bb=['N','CA','C','O']
pl_P=list(range(212,225)); pl_S=list(range(220,233))
P=np.array([rP[i]['atoms'][a] for i in pl_P for a in bb]); S=np.array([rS[i]['atoms'][a] for i in pl_S for a in bb])
R,pc,qc=kabsch(S,P); rmsd=np.sqrt((((S-pc)@R+qc-P)**2).sum(1).mean())
toP=lambda X:(X-pc)@R+qc
A=[];Lb=[]
for k in sdf['order']:
    for an,x in sdf['res'][k]['atoms'].items(): A.append(x); Lb.append((sdf['res'][k]['rn'],sdf['res'][k]['ri'],an))
A=toP(np.array(A))
ptr=[(h[3],h[4]) for h in pty['het'] if h[1]=='PTR' and h[2]==323]
nm=[a[0] for a in ptr]; X=np.array([a[1] for a in ptr])
D=np.linalg.norm(X[:,None,:]-A[None,:,:],axis=-1); md=D.min(1); am=D.argmin(1)
PA=[];
for k in pty['order']:
    for an,x in pty['res'][k]['atoms'].items(): PA.append(x)
PA=np.array(PA); mdp=np.linalg.norm(X[:,None,:]-PA[None,:,:],axis=-1).min(1)
# key distances
gS=np.mean([rS[229]['atoms'][n] for n in ['NE','CZ','NH1','NH2']],0); gS=toP(gS[None])[0]
gP=np.mean([rP[221]['atoms'][n] for n in ['NE','CZ','NH1','NH2']],0)
Pp=X[nm.index('P')]
e171=min(np.linalg.norm(toP(rS[171]['atoms'][a][None])[0]-Pp) for a in ['OE1','OE2'])
d181=min(np.linalg.norm(rP[181]['atoms'][a]-Pp) for a in ['OD1','OD2'] if a in rP[181]['atoms'])
plddt={r:rS[r]['b'] for r in list(range(34,46))+list(range(165,178))+list(range(218,236))}

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(14,8.5))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,3,height_ratios=[1,1],hspace=0.55,wspace=0.32)
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:2])
x=np.arange(len(nm)); w=0.4
ax.bar(x-w/2,mdp,w,color='#4C72B0',label='pTyr in its own PTP1B pocket (1PTY)')
ax.bar(x+w/2,md,w,color='#C44E52',label='same pTyr placed in SDF-9 (P-loop superposition, RMSD %.2f A)'%rmsd)
ax.axhline(2.6,ls='--',c='k',lw=1); ax.text(-0.4,2.75,'2.6 A steric clash',fontsize=8)
for i in range(len(nm)):
    if md[i]<2.6: ax.text(i+w/2, md[i]+0.08, Lb[am[i]][0]+str(Lb[am[i]][1]), rotation=90, fontsize=6, ha='center')
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(nm,rotation=90,fontsize=8); ax.set_ylim(0,6.2)
ax.set_ylabel('closest protein heavy atom (A)')
ax.set_title('A  A phosphotyrosine cannot occupy the SDF-9 active site: %d/%d atoms clash (PTP1B %d/%d)'%((md<2.6).sum(),len(nm),(mdp<2.6).sum(),len(nm)),fontsize=10,loc='left')
ax.legend(fontsize=7.5,loc='upper left')

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,2])
labels=['SDF-9 R229\nvs PTP1B R221\nguanidinium','SDF-9 R229\nto phosphate P','PTP1B R221\nto phosphate P','SDF-9 E171\nCOO- to P','PTP1B D181\nCOO- to P']
vals=[np.linalg.norm(gS-gP),np.linalg.norm(gS-Pp),np.linalg.norm(gP-Pp),e171,d181]
cols=['#55A868','#55A868','#4C72B0','#C44E52','#4C72B0']
ax.barh(range(5),vals,color=cols); ax.set_yticks(range(5)); ax.set_yticklabels(labels,fontsize=7.5)
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax.text(v+0.1,i,f'{v:.2f} A',va='center',fontsize=8)
ax.invert_yaxis(); ax.set_xlabel('distance (A)'); ax.set_xlim(0,max(vals)*1.35)
ax.set_title('B  Arg cradle preserved,\n   general acid position clashes',fontsize=10,loc='left')

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,:])
ks=sorted(plddt); ax.bar(range(len(ks)),[plddt[k] for k in ks],
       color=['#C44E52' if k<46 else ('#DD8452' if k<178 else '#55A868') for k in ks])
ax.set_xticks(range(len(ks))); ax.set_xticklabels([f"{AA3[rS[k]['rn']]}{k}" for k in ks],rotation=90,fontsize=7)
ax.axhline(70,ls='--',c='k',lw=1); ax.text(0,71.5,'pLDDT 70',fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel('pLDDT'); ax.set_ylim(0,100)
ax.set_title('C  AlphaFold confidence: pTyr-recognition-loop region 34-45 (red) is low confidence; "WPD" loop 165-177 (orange) and P-loop 218-235 (green) are confident',fontsize=9.5,loc='left')
plt.suptitle('SDF-9 (G5EGA9) modelled against phosphotyrosine-bound PTP1B (1PTY, C215S trapping mutant)',fontsize=11,y=0.985)
plt.show()
print('P-loop backbone RMSD %.2f A; pTyr clashes in SDF-9 %d/%d, in PTP1B %d/%d'%(rmsd,(md<2.6).sum(),len(nm),(mdp<2.6).sum(),len(nm)))
print('R229-R221 guanidinium %.2f A; R229-P %.2f A; R221-P %.2f A; E171 COO--P %.2f A; D181 COO--P %.2f A'%tuple(vals))
print('mean pLDDT 34-45 %.1f | 165-177 %.1f | 218-235 %.1f'%(np.mean([plddt[k] for k in ks if k<46]),np.mean([plddt[k] for k in ks if 46<k<178]),np.mean([plddt[k] for k in ks if k>177])))
